topics.description: Multiple investigations are underway in Minnesota into various fraud schemes, including a $21 million Medicaid fraud scheme and a $90 million fraud scheme involving 15 accused individuals.
topics.reason: The number of investigations and the large amounts of money involved are causing concern.

topics.description: A hearing was held in Minnesota regarding a $9 billion Somali fraud scheme, with GOP lawmakers grilling Minnesota Gov. Walz and AG Ellison.
topics.reason: The large amount of money involved and the political scrutiny are causing attention.
